items.text: Have the bookkeeper reconcile LNB checking
items.summary: CFO pulled the live bank feed on 11/1. LNB shows $72,619 at the bank but -$74,276 in QuickBooks, a $146.9K gap, and 52 feed items are still unreviewed (down from 70). Until it's reconciled, the books can't back cash calls. No cost; it just needs your OK to contact her, with a target of 11/9.

items.text: Move TikTok recovery off sales@ and set up a quotes@ lead alias
items.summary: TikTok's account recovery is still sales@ because TikTok refused the change on the web; it can only be changed in the TikTok phone app (about 10 minutes, free). Devil's Advocate and Marketing also want a quotes@ shared alias so leads don't depend on one inbox, then one test message into each lead inbox.
items.rec: Do it. You change the recovery email in the TikTok app; bots set up and test the alias.

items.text: OK the 24-hour lead nudge (only when we owe the reply)
